caption: Two bumper cars at a fairground drive straight at each other, meet head-on, and both cars bounce back a little.

sa.check: Two bumper cars are being driven at a fairground.
They drive straight at each other.
Both cars bounce back a little.
Both cars rebound rather than only one.
The approach comes first, then the contact, then the rebound.

pc.expect: At the contact both cars stop or reverse, each moving back along the line it came in on.
pc.fail: The cars carry on at their old speed through the contact; or only one car is affected while the other drives on unchanged; or both move off together in one direction after a head-on meeting.

pc.expect: Each car changes its motion at the moment the bumpers touch and not before.
pc.fail: A car bounces back before the bumpers touch; or a car is thrown back with the other never reaching it; or a car stops short of contact and the other rebounds anyway.

pc.expect: The two cars meet at their bumpers and stay outside one another.
pc.fail: One car passes through the other; or the bumpers overlap and the bodies run into each other; or a car passes through the floor of the rink.

pc.expect: The rubber bumpers squash briefly at the contact and spring back, and the shells stay rigid.
pc.fail: A bumper stays dented after the contact; or a car body crumples like paper; or the cars stick together at the bumpers and travel on as one.

pc.expect: Two cars and their riders keep their number and shape.
pc.fail: A car vanishes at the contact or a third appears; or a car turns into another vehicle; or a rider comes away from a car and stays sitting in mid-air.

pc.expect: The cars' colours, the rink floor and the fairground behind stay the same.
pc.fail: A car changes colour at the contact; or the rink's markings shift between frames; or the fairground behind rearranges.
